summary:
EarthPulse is an innovative environmental monitoring project that aims to understand and track changes happening on our planet using NASA satellite data and Earth observation technology.
The project focuses on important environmental challenges such as climate change, global warming, deforestation, floods, and environmental degradation. It aims to transform complex satellite data into simple, meaningful information that people can easily understand.
EarthPulse promotes environmental awareness, supports better decision-making, and encourages communities to protect our planet. By connecting space technology with real-world environmental problems, it aims to contribute to a safer, greener, and more sustainable future.
details:
EarthPulse – Understanding Our Changing Planet

EarthPulse is an innovative Earth observation project designed to help people understand, monitor, and respond to environmental changes on our planet. The project focuses on using satellite observations and Earth science data to explore important environmental issues such as climate change, global warming, deforestation, land degradation, floods, and changes in weather patterns.

The main goal of EarthPulse is to transform complex environmental information into understandable and useful insights. By presenting Earth-related information in a clear and accessible way, the project aims to increase environmental awareness and support better decision-making.

EarthPulse uses Earth observation data and scientific information to help identify environmental changes over time. The project aims to present these findings through a simple and user-friendly platform, allowing users to understand environmental conditions and recognize potential risks.
